tv: Xiaomi Smart Projector (C025RGN, tianshan, FORMOVIE ODM, MediaTek T32)
notes: Xiaomi-branded but a FORMOVIE build on the same tianshan board as [xiaomi-smart-projector-l1-pro-tianshan](xiaomi-smart-projector-l1-pro-tianshan/), on Android 14: no `com.xiaomi.*` or `com.mitv.*` package exists on it at all, so no PatchWall, MiChannel or TV Manager to disable; 11 Google telemetry, Privacy Sandbox (Topics API, ad attribution, on-device personalisation) and Health Connect packages off, plus 6 preloads the owner does not use (GMM One HD, APKPure, TCL browser, Google TV Movies, Play Games, the Kaltura demo player), all still disabled after a reboot; `com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter` and YouTube Music ship disabled from the factory while Prime Video ships enabled, so Prime Video is kept here; the three `uk.co.freeview.*` services and `com.google.android.syncadapters.calendar` stay on (the L1 Pro list disables them); `com.fengmi.*` (focus, keystone, BLE remote) and `com.mediatek.*` kept, streaming apps, Assistant, Chromecast, TalkBack and the Ambient screensaver kept by choice; Android 14 resolves HOME by intent priority (launcherx 2, setupwraith 1, sideloaded 0) so `set-home-activity` prints Success and changes nothing, and the saved Wi-Fi belongs to setupwraith on a Wi-Fi-only set, so both stay enabled and the launcher takes Home through the Home-key redirect (`HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1`, config.json; Volume repeat is lost, and `build-and-install.sh` exits on its Home check after installing the APK but before enabling the helper); `pm disable-user` on `com.google.android.videos` first left it uninstalled for user 0, so it needs `pm install-existing --user 0` to come back; sideloading a HOME package works; one-session test, not a several-day soak
